integrity: The proof combines exact prime-exponent threshold enumeration, outward-rounded interval arithmetic for 42 finite contacts, and Robin's unconditional bound excluding all larger contacts. The standalone verifier computes these inequalities and reproduces two published normalization cases.
scientific_limitations: Exact first-transition theorem only for Musin A_k(1,2), not later transitions or all higher-order hierarchies. The source ancillary interval archive was not independently accessed.
title: First transition at order 17 in the power-abscissa colossally abundant hierarchy
